visual_logic.surface_detail: Highly specialized, tightly packed scales that appear almost smooth and skin-like; a deep navy-blue body with high-visibility silver 'racing stripes' along the lateral line.
visual_logic.environment: Deep oceanic water with a heavy 'marine snow' effect to provide a sense of speed and depth.
visual_logic.cinematic_effect: Motion blur on the tail fluke to emphasize its high-speed 'thunniform' swimming style, with bubbles trailing from the leading edges of the flippers.

pose: A dynamic 'torpedo' lunge toward the upper corner of the frame. The body is rigid and muscular, highlighting its advanced evolution into a tuna-like shape, with the large, crescent tail fluke providing a powerful push.
